column1: # The one case table of `validate::secret_entry`, run by the Rust core and
# the Swift helper's mirror alike (KeyboardInputSafetyTests.swift reads this
# file). Columns: writes_text, pastes, secure_field, secure_input_on,
# secure_input_by_receiver, focus_read → verdict. A secure field is the
# platform's own secret-field subrole — never a word. Secure mode held by the
# app the keys go to, or held while the focus cannot be read, counts as one.
